006package gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.metapath.item.atomic;
007
008import gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.datatype.adapter.MetaschemaDataTypeProvider;
009import gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.metapath.function.ArithmeticFunctionException;
010import gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.metapath.function.CastFunctionException;
011import gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.metapath.function.InvalidValueForCastFunctionException;
012import gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.metapath.item.atomic.impl.IntegerItemImpl;
013import gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.metapath.type.IAtomicOrUnionType;
014import gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.metapath.type.InvalidTypeMetapathException;
015import gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.util.ObjectUtils;
016
017import java.math.BigInteger;
018
019import edu.umd.cs.findbugs.annotations.NonNull;
020
021/**
022 * An atomic Metapath item containing an integer data value.
023 */
024public interface IIntegerItem extends IDecimalItem {
025  /**
026   * The integer value "1".
027   */
028  @NonNull
029  IIntegerItem ONE = valueOf(ObjectUtils.notNull(BigInteger.ONE));
030  /**
031   * The integer value "0".
032   */
033  @NonNull
034  IIntegerItem ZERO = valueOf(ObjectUtils.notNull(BigInteger.ZERO));
035  /**
036   * The integer value "-1".
037   */
038  @NonNull
039  IIntegerItem NEGATIVE_ONE = valueOf(ObjectUtils.notNull(BigInteger.ONE.negate()));
040
041  /**
042   * Get the type information for this item.
043   *
044   * @return the type information
045   */
046  @NonNull
047  static IAtomicOrUnionType<IIntegerItem> type() {
048    return MetaschemaDataTypeProvider.INTEGER.getItemType();
049  }
050
051  @Override
052  default IAtomicOrUnionType<? extends IIntegerItem> getType() {
053    return type();
054  }
055
056  /**
057   * Create an item from an existing integer value.
058   *
059   * @param value
060   *          a string representing an integer value
061   * @return the item
062   * @throws InvalidTypeMetapathException
063   *           if the provided value is not an integer
064   */
065  @NonNull
066  static IIntegerItem valueOf(@NonNull String value) {
067    try {
068      return valueOf(MetaschemaDataTypeProvider.INTEGER.parse(value));
069    } catch (IllegalArgumentException ex) {
070      throw new InvalidTypeMetapathException(null,
071          ex.getMessage(),
072          ex);
073    }
074  }
075
076  /**
077   * Construct a new integer item using the provided {@code value}.
078   *
079   * @param value
080   *          a long value
081   * @return the new item
082   */
083  @NonNull
084  static IIntegerItem valueOf(int value) {
085    @SuppressWarnings("null")
086    @NonNull
087    BigInteger bigInteger = BigInteger.valueOf(value);
088    return valueOf(bigInteger);
089  }
090
091  /**
092   * Construct a new integer item using the provided {@code value}.
093   *
094   * @param value
095   *          a long value
096   * @return the new item
097   */
098  @NonNull
099  static IIntegerItem valueOf(long value) {
100    @SuppressWarnings("null")
101    @NonNull
102    BigInteger bigInteger = BigInteger.valueOf(value);
103    return valueOf(bigInteger);
104  }
105
106  /**
107   * Construct a new integer item using the provided {@code value}.
108   *
109   * @param value
110   *          a long value
111   * @return the new item
112   */
113  @NonNull
114  static IIntegerItem valueOf(boolean value) {
115    return valueOf(ObjectUtils.notNull(value ? BigInteger.ONE : BigInteger.ZERO));
116  }
117
118  /**
119   * Construct a new integer item using the provided {@code value}.
120   *
121   * @param value
122   *          an integer value
123   * @return the new item
124   */
125  @NonNull
126  static IIntegerItem valueOf(@NonNull BigInteger value) {
127    int signum = value.signum();
128
129    IIntegerItem retval;
130    if (signum == -1) { // negative
131      retval = new IntegerItemImpl(value);
132    } else if (signum == 0) { // zero
133      retval = INonNegativeIntegerItem.valueOf(value);
134    } else { // positive
135      retval = IPositiveIntegerItem.valueOf(value);
136    }
137    return retval;
138  }
139
140  /**
141   * Cast the provided type to this item type.
142   *
143   * @param item
144   *          the item to cast
145   * @return the original item if it is already this type, otherwise a new item
146   *         cast to this type
147   * @throws InvalidValueForCastFunctionException
148   *           if the provided {@code item} cannot be cast to this type
149   */
150  @NonNull
151  static IIntegerItem cast(@NonNull IAnyAtomicItem item) {
152    IIntegerItem retval;
153    if (item instanceof IIntegerItem) {
154      retval = (IIntegerItem) item;
155    } else if (item instanceof INumericItem) {
156      retval = valueOf(((INumericItem) item).asInteger());
157    } else if (item instanceof IBooleanItem) {
158      retval = valueOf(((IBooleanItem) item).toBoolean());
159    } else {
160      try {
161        retval = valueOf(item.asString());
162      } catch (IllegalStateException | InvalidTypeMetapathException ex) {
163        // asString can throw IllegalStateException exception
164        throw new InvalidValueForCastFunctionException(ex);
165      }
166    }
167    return retval;
168  }
169
170  @Override
171  default IIntegerItem castAsType(IAnyAtomicItem item) {
172    return cast(item);
173  }
174
175  @Override
176  default IIntegerItem abs() {
177    BigInteger value = asInteger();
178    return value.signum() > -1 ? this : valueOf(ObjectUtils.notNull(value.abs()));
179  }
180
181  @Override
182  default IIntegerItem ceiling() {
183    return this;
184  }
185
186  @Override
187  default IIntegerItem floor() {
188    return this;
189  }
190
191  /**
192   * Convert this integer item to a Java int, precisely.
193   *
194   * @return the int value
195   * @throws CastFunctionException
196   *           if the value does not fit in an int
197   */
198  @Override
199  default int toIntValueExact() {
200    // asInteger() is well-defined for integer items, so this should be safe
201    try {
202      return asInteger().intValueExact();
203    } catch (ArithmeticException ex) {
204      throw new CastFunctionException(
205          CastFunctionException.INPUT_VALUE_TOO_LARGE,
206          this,
207          String.format("Integer value '%s' is out of range for a Java int.", asString()),
208          ex);
209    }
210  }
211
212  /**
213   * Create a new sum by adding this value to the provided addend value.
214   *
215   * @param addend
216   *          the second value to sum
217   * @return a new value resulting from adding this value to the provided addend
218   *         value
219   */
220  @NonNull
221  default IIntegerItem add(@NonNull IIntegerItem addend) {
222    BigInteger addendLeft = asInteger();
223    BigInteger addendRight = addend.asInteger();
224    return valueOf(ObjectUtils.notNull(addendLeft.add(addendRight)));
225  }
226
227  /**
228   * Determine the difference by subtracting the provided subtrahend value from
229   * this minuend value.
230   *
231   * @param subtrahend
232   *          the value to subtract
233   * @return a new value resulting from subtracting the subtrahend from the
234   *         minuend
235   */
236  @NonNull
237  default IIntegerItem subtract(@NonNull IIntegerItem subtrahend) {
238    BigInteger minuendInteger = asInteger();
239    BigInteger subtrahendInteger = subtrahend.asInteger();
240    return valueOf(ObjectUtils.notNull(minuendInteger.subtract(subtrahendInteger)));
241  }
242
243  /**
244   * Multiply this multiplicand value by the provided multiplier value.
245   *
246   * @param multiplier
247   *          the value to multiply by
248   * @return a new value resulting from multiplying the multiplicand by the
249   *         multiplier
250   */
251  @NonNull
252  default IIntegerItem multiply(@NonNull IIntegerItem multiplier) {
253    return valueOf(ObjectUtils.notNull(asInteger().multiply(multiplier.asInteger())));
254  }
255
256  /**
257   * Divide this dividend value by the provided divisor value using integer
258   * division.
259   *
260   * @param divisor
261   *          the value to divide by
262   * @return a new value resulting from dividing the dividend by the divisor
263   */
264  @NonNull
265  default IIntegerItem integerDivide(@NonNull IIntegerItem divisor) {
266    BigInteger divisorInteger = divisor.asInteger();
267
268    if (BigInteger.ZERO.equals(divisorInteger)) {
269      throw new ArithmeticFunctionException(ArithmeticFunctionException.DIVISION_BY_ZERO,
270          ArithmeticFunctionException.DIVISION_BY_ZERO_MESSAGE);
271    }
272    return valueOf(ObjectUtils.notNull(asInteger().divide(divisorInteger)));
273  }
274
275  /**
276   * Compute the remainder when dividing this dividend value by the provided
277   * divisor value.
278   *
279   * @param divisor
280   *          the value to divide by
281   * @return a new value containing the remainder resulting from dividing the
282   *         dividend by the divisor
283   */
284  @NonNull
285  default IIntegerItem mod(@NonNull IIntegerItem divisor) {
286    BigInteger divisorInteger = divisor.asInteger();
287
288    if (BigInteger.ZERO.equals(divisorInteger)) {
289      throw new ArithmeticFunctionException(ArithmeticFunctionException.DIVISION_BY_ZERO,
290          ArithmeticFunctionException.DIVISION_BY_ZERO_MESSAGE);
291    }
292
293    return valueOf(ObjectUtils.notNull(asInteger().remainder(divisorInteger)));
294  }
295
296  @Override
297  default IIntegerItem negate() {
298    return valueOf(ObjectUtils.notNull(asInteger().negate()));
299  }
300
301  /**
302   * Compares this value with the argument.
303   *
304   * @param item
305   *          the item to compare with this value
306   * @return a negative integer, zero, or a positive integer if this value is less
307   *         than, equal to, or greater than the {@code item}.
308   */
309  default int compareTo(IIntegerItem item) {
310    return asInteger().compareTo(item.asInteger());
311  }
312}
